card_title: Artist Notes: Keratin-Bond Repair Hair Mask
summary: Intensive trauma recovery. A dense treatment mask that repairs broken disulfide bonds in chemically or thermally damaged hair.
description: Cellular reconstruction for compromised strands. This high-performance mask penetrates deep into the hair cortex, replacing lost proteins and reinforcing the internal keratin structure for dramatically increased elasticity.
technical_overview: Offered at $38.0 for 200ml, this KoColor HAIR_MASK is expertly formulated with Hydrolyzed Keratin, Amino Acids, and Shea Butter. It delivers a high-fidelity Ivory Cream color profile (`#FFFFF0`) and leverages low-molecular-weight protein synthesis.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Apply to towel-dried hair once a week. Leave on for 15-20 minutes before rinsing thoroughly.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Wrap hair in a warm, damp towel while the mask processes; the heat expands the cuticle for deeper protein penetration.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Hydrolyzed keratin is broken down to a molecular size small enough to physically fill the micro-tears in the hair shaft.
